_comment: Manual corrections applied after the Wikidata selection and the Wikipedia-category fallback. forceInclude: stage works that Wikidata types as opera/album or not at all (value = why). forceExclude: false positives (value = why). preferList: which of an article's production lists to use when its own notes can't tell the builder (value = { label: a regex matched against the list's label, why }). Keys are Wikidata QIDs.

forceInclude.Q740920: Porgy and Bess - typed as an opera, but widely performed as musical theatre and sung at STAR
forceInclude.Q5737404: Here Lies Love - the item is typed as an album; the article covers the staged musical
forceInclude.Q124022523: Paddington: The Musical - 2025 item has no type yet
forceInclude.Q131747572: Just in Time (musical) - 2025 item has no type yet
forceInclude.Q7623880: Striking 12 - an Off-Broadway stage musical (2006); the article's first infobox is its cast album's
forceInclude.Q7426602: Saturday's Warrior - a 1973 stage musical (Category:1973 musicals); the article also covers the 1989 film, whose infobox comes first

forceExclude.Q12125897: Lovestruck: The Musical - a TV film
forceExclude.Q20711488: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child - a play
forceExclude.Q131373019: Epic: The Musical - a concept-album series, not a staged work
forceExclude.Q7770334: The Tropicana Holiday - a Las Vegas striptease/showgirl revue, not a stage musical students perform (found only through Category:Revues)
forceExclude.Q2511457: Love (Cirque du Soleil) - a contemporary-circus show set to the Beatles' recordings (found only through Category:2006 musicals), not a stage musical

Q251667.label: ^US tour
Q251667.why: Shrek the Musical - the article's notes say Dragon's "Forever" replaced "Donkey Pot Pie" from the first tour on in all subsequent productions; the US tour list is the licensed version

Q7775315.label: ^London
Q7775315.why: The Witches of Eastwick - the original London production's score ("Eye of the Beholder" …); the lists that name singers are later regional/foreign productions

Q5046194.label: ^Off-Broadway revival
Q5046194.why: Carrie (musical) - the 2012 Off-Broadway revival is the rewritten version that is licensed and performed today ("Dreamer in Disguise", "You Shine"); the 1988 Broadway list is the withdrawn original
